queries.result: Arabic discovery found the official ANCFCC Arabic cadastre/conservation mandate and public-service pages. The official Safi-Youssoufia atlas PDF was also inspected; it is a 2024 province planning/territorial atlas and does not publish parcel identities or parcel polygons. registryBasis: ANCFCC is the evidenced national cadastral and land-conservation custodian and its official external-office directory lists a Safi Conservation Foncière and Cadastre office. This establishes custodian/procedure evidence, not a public citywide parcel registry or anonymous parcel API.

officialSources.observation: Official ANCFCC page describes national land registration, cadastre, cadastral plans, archives, and making current cadastral data available to users; it does not expose an anonymous city parcel query in the inspected page.
Official ANCFCC external-office directory lists Safi Conservation Foncière and Safi Cadastre at Quartier Administratif, Avenue Mohamed V, ville nouvelle, BP 15.
Official online cadastral-plan service requires user/request information and a title/cadastre number; it is not an open parcel-browse or citywide geometry service.
Official Safi-Youssoufia Urban Agency page links the 2024 Atlas-Province-SAFI.pdf. The atlas is planning/territorial context, not a parcel API or parcel dataset.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ANCFCC national cadastral pages and Safi office directory, ANCFCC cadastral-plan service, and the official Safi-Youssoufia Urban Agency atlas page/PDF were investigated.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National/local custodian and procedure evidence plus planning/territorial atlas context only; no anonymous parcel identity-plus-geometry response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Safi cadastral office and ANCFCC mandate are evidenced, but public parcel publication, citywide coverage, and API access remain unresolved. HTTP 403 and the absence of a parcel layer in the planning atlas are access/content findings, not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No claim is made about ownership, title, address, tax records, legal descriptions, or completeness of internal ANCFCC or local datasets. Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
